cands.name: Arthur Boyer
cands.bio: Democrat. Educator and leadership coach with an Ed.D. in organizational leadership, an MPA, and a criminal justice management degree; CEO of Boyer Multidisciplinary Consultant; former Collier County English teacher and Hodges University adjunct professor.
cands.local_ties: Two decades of work with students and community groups across Southwest Florida; taught in Collier County Public Schools 2004-2009 (BallotReady, campaign site).

record.text: No prior elected office. Priorities: housing and affordability; schools, healthcare and rights; water, land and resilience.

money_notes.text: Raised $7,539 from 60 donors; no political committee money and no affiliated committee (Sparker's Soapbox).

endorsements.text: Former Collier County Commissioner Frank Halas; Democratic Environmental Caucus of Florida; Gun Sense Voter.

cands.gaps: Photo is the lead portrait on his own campaign site (not independently confirmed by caption). Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

cands.name: Liesa Priddy
cands.bio: Republican, open seat (Rep. Lauren Melo not running). Third-generation Florida rancher; operates JB Ranch in Collier County with her husband Russell; began in banking and law firm administration. Appointed to the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission by Gov. Rick Scott.
cands.local_ties: Based in Immokalee; family ranching roots in Collier County (campaign site via Sparker's Soapbox).

record.text: Former Region 5 representative of the Florida Cattlemen's Association (3 years); appointed to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission by Gov. Rick Scott; JB Ranch won conservation awards. Priorities: Second Amendment, lower homeowner's insurance, lower taxes, private property rights.

money_notes.text: Campaign took in $237,454 including $46,000 from political committees; her committee Friends of Liesa Priddy has raised $26,500 (Sparker's Soapbox summary of state filings).
Florida Politics reported she raised $151K early in her run, and later passed $215K.

endorsements.text: Agriculture Commissioner Wilton Simpson; Collier Sheriff Kevin Rambosk and Hendry Sheriff Steve Whidden; Reps. Lauren Melo, Adam Botana, Yvette Benarroch; Florida Cattlemen's Association, Farm Bureau, Florida Chamber, Florida Medical Association, AIF, Americans for Prosperity (per her campaign site).
Wilton Simpson backs Priddy (June 2026); Lauren Melo named her preferred successor.

cands.gaps: No photo found (site image is a ranch landscape). Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.
